Thanks for taking a look — Kooth is exploring a tighter integration with Redwood to power our internal content retrieval and to add request-level tracing for production observability. Our engineering team is specifically interested in: 

- A LlamaIndex-backed connector for our FAQ + clinician notes (low-latency rerank + streaming responses)
- Trace SDK hooks to capture per-request model variant, latency, and fallback events into our telemetry pipeline

We have basic prototypes but want to understand Redwood's recommended pattern for: model selection with quantized variants, prefix/KV caching strategy for short clinical prompts, and sampling telemetry schema.

Would love to set up a 30-45m technical sync next week with your integration folks. I can loop in Arjun (engineering).

Hi Devon — quick technical note ahead of our sync. I put together a short spec that maps to your asks. Highlights: 

- LlamaIndex connector pattern: recommend a two-tier retrieval flow (dense ANN + short token prefix rerank) to keep 95th p99 token latency < 350ms for typical queries. Use a small embedding model for candidate filtering, then rerank with a quantized 8-bit Llama variant for the final synthesis.
- Caching: enable KV cache for repeated conversation prefixes and apply a short-lived prefix cache (TTL ~30s) for clinician sessions. This reduces end-to-end token cost by ~18% in similar customers.
- Trace SDK hooks: add events for model_variant, batch_size, cache_hit (boolean), fallback_to_lower_tier_model, and kv_eviction. Export via OTLP to your telemetry; we can also push to an S3/CloudWatch sink.

I attached a working draft: kooth-trace-integration-spec.md — it includes sample spans and a suggested OTLP mapping.

If you want, we can propose a 3-week pilot: week 1 - connector + trace scaffold, week 2 - load/latency tuning, week 3 - production hardening + SLO runbook. Pricing would be pilot-rate + effort estimate in the SOW.

Attachments: kooth-trace-integration-spec.md (text/markdown)

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

2) On the Trace SDK side, can you confirm Otel span attributes names? We standardize on camelCase attributes and want to avoid translation layers.

Tue 2026-11-30 09:30 PT works for us — calendar invite incoming. A few quick answers: 

- Latency: in our benchmarks a quantized 8-bit Llama variant at sequence length 512 shows ~12–18% slower per-token execution time compared to 16-bit on the same GPU, but the model footprint allows higher batching so overall throughput often improves; we'll bring benchmark slides to the meeting.
- OTLP attribute names: Karthik's draft uses snake_case. Karthik — can you add a camelCase mapping table in the spec? That will keep Kooth's pipeline happy.

I've also attached a baseline SOW draft to accelerate procurement conversations. If Kooth wants to proceed after the pilot we'll issue a DocuSign SOW.
